motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Scroll-linked settle: the Frames move with --d and --ad in 560ms.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: UI responses: press, disc, switch, FAQ icon, Chapter in, strip lock, odometer, sent state.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Pill and ghost press; background and border color changes.

motion.name: frame-settle
motion.purpose: A Frame moves to its new place in the fan.

motion.name: disc-and-switch
motion.purpose: Arrow disc shift, switch knob slide, FAQ plus rotation.

motion.name: strip-lock
motion.purpose: A new segment locks into the project strip.

motion.name: odometer-roll
motion.purpose: Each digit column of the total rolls to the new value.

motion.name: sent
motion.purpose: The success state of the form.

motion.name: store-in
motion.purpose: The shown store card comes in. The old card goes out in 180ms. A switch from the keyboard is instant.

motion.name: store-timer
motion.purpose: The timer line along the bottom edge of the shown store tile. Then the next store shows, while the section is in view, until the visitor picks one.

motion.name: copy-pop
motion.purpose: The pass check that takes the place of the copy icon after a copy.

motion.name: virtual-scroll
motion.value: current += (target - current) * (1 - exp(-dt * 8)); dt max 64ms; snap under 0.1px
motion.purpose: Each animation frame eases the page toward the target. The page loops through the Twin copy.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All durations go to 0. The Virtual scroll jumps to its target. The Filmstrip uses row mode. Chapters only cross-fade in 200ms. Store cards only fade in 200ms; the store timer and the automatic move stop; recordings do not play.

breakpoints.name: package-table
breakpoints.purpose: The package table becomes a 2-column card per row; the head row hides.

breakpoints.name: store-stack
breakpoints.purpose: The store card goes to one column; the stage goes on top.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.purpose: Nav links hide; the Project builder stacks; the estimate stops being sticky.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Process, FAQ, and the contact panel go to one column.

breakpoints.name: row-mode
breakpoints.purpose: The Filmstrip becomes a swipe row (also under reduced motion).

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Timeline end labels hide; the form is one column; store tiles show only the thumbnail and the name; the store pill fills the row.

breakpoints.name: nav-pill
breakpoints.purpose: The nav pill shows only its arrow disc.

narrative.overview:
The Home page reads as the audit report that Luan sends to a store owner. A Demo store loads Frame by Frame, then the page prices the work and books the call. The ground is near-white. The text is near-black ink. Hairline report rules divide the content. One pass-green accent marks only the live element: the active Frame, the key line of a section, the total, and the focus.

One tight grotesk (Geist) carries the display sizes and the body. A mono (Geist Mono) carries only measured data: timestamps, metrics, prices in the Project builder, dates. Content sits in rounded 20px tiles. Actions are pills. State shows as a mark (a check, a tick, a flag, a filled dot), never as a new hue. The page is light only.

The page has one center axis for the hero, the Timeline, and the fan of Frames. The sections below it are left-aligned report blocks. The Virtual scroll moves the page and loops from the footer back to the top. The page refuses the dark freelancer template and the cream editorial portfolio.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white ground, ink text, one pass-green accent on the live element only.
Geist for all words; Geist Mono for measured data only.
20px tiles with a hairline ring; pill actions with an arrow disc.
Hairline rules as structure: table rows, switch rows, FAQ rows, the Timeline, the Page map.
State as a mark, not as a color.
One center axis on the first screen; report blocks below.

rules.name: The Live Element Rule
rules.body: Pass green marks only the thing that is live now: the active Frame, the active timestamp, the total, the key phrase, the focus. Never use it as a fill for a section or a button.

rules.name: The Mark Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Show state with a mark: a check disc, a flag disc, a filled dot, an inverted pill. Do not add a new color for a state. Warn rust is the only exception, and only for form errors.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Use Geist Mono only for a value that is measured or counted: a time, a metric, a price line, a date. Words stay in Geist.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Text at 1.375rem or larger uses weight 620 or more and negative tracking (-0.025em to -0.055em). Body text keeps normal tracking.

rules.name: The Ring Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: A tile that holds a report (table, panel, demo) gets the hairline ring. Only a tile that is a live object (a Frame, the estimate) gets a drop shadow.

dos: Do keep pass green on the live element only: the active Frame, the active timestamp, the key phrase, the total, the focus.
Do show state with a mark (check disc, flag disc, filled dot, inverted pill) on ink and white.
Do put measured numbers in Geist Mono with tabular figures, and all words in Geist.
Do use 20px tiles; give report tiles the hairline ring and live tiles the tile shadow.
Do make every action a pill; the primary action is ink with the white arrow disc.
Do ease scroll-linked motion with `cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)` and UI responses with `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`.
Do honor reduced motion: the Virtual scroll jumps to its target, the Filmstrip shows the swipe row, and Chapters only cross-fade in 200ms.
Do apply hover styles only for a fine pointer that can hover.
Do label every Demo store "Demo" and mark every Mock value with the dashed note.
donts: Don't add a dark theme or a dark section. The color scheme is light only.
Don't add a second accent hue, or use green as a large fill.
Don't use the mono for headings, labels, or running text.
Don't use square buttons or square tiles.
Don't add drop shadows to flat report tiles; use the hairline ring.
Don't add a small uppercase label above a section heading. A section opens with its heading.
Don't show a native scrollbar under the Virtual scroll; the Page map takes its place.
